newsitem.title: USA: Ithaca Industries reorganization plan approved.
newsitem.headline: Ithaca Industries reorganization plan approved.

text.p: Ithaca Industries Inc said Friday that its pre-packaged bankruptcy reorganization plan has been confirmed by the court.
The plan was filed on October 8, when it began Chapter 11 proceedings.

The plan gives holders of Ithaca's 11.125 percent senior subordinated notes 100 percent of the company's outstanding common stock and allows a bank credit agreement to be restructured, effectively eliminating 50 percent of its debt.
The company said the plan also provides for the claims of its trade creditors to be paid in full.
Ithaca Industries designs, markets and manufactures underwear, hosiery and T-shirts.
